name: How to Make a DDLC Mod
source:
Monika attempts to teach you how to make DDLC mods, but only in Ren'Py 7 since that's what was used to make this mod. 

[Edited from [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/htmaddlcm/]DokiMods[/url]]
translation:
Monika尝试教你如何制作DDLC模组，但仅限于Ren'Py 7，因为这就是制作此模组的工具。

[编辑自[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/htmaddlcm/]DokiMods[/url]]
